content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIM Udaipur Research Assistant/Associate Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Udaipur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Udaipur Research Assistant/Associate position?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Research Assistant/Associate position at IIM Udaipur is 14 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess Chartered Accountancy (CA) or MBA (Finance) or a Master's in Quantitative/Computational Finance from a reputed Institute. Proficiency in Excel and any statistical package is expected, with knowledge of Python or R being preferred.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Research Assistant/Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Assistant/Associate position at IIM Udaipur.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is online.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this position?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for the Research Assistant/Associate position?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is Contract.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the Important Links section of this article or by visiting the official website of IIM Udaipur.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant/Associate role?
faq.answer: The salary and compensation will be competitive and aligned with the candidate's qualification and experience, following IIMU norms for Research Assistants/Associates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is located in Udaipur, Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply offline for this position?
faq.answer: No, applications must be submitted online only through the provided application portal.
